units.source_text: 昨日的女人把我太当做一般人来接待了，

en.t: The woman yesterday had treated me far too much like an ordinary person,

units.source_text: 所以我今天将前几天在旧书店里买来的一部！日文库本的书揣在衣兜里前去了。

en.t: so today I went there with a paperback book I had bought a few days earlier at a secondhand bookstore tucked into my pocket.

units.source_text: 这是贝卡里亚的（犯罪与刑罚），

en.t: It was Beccaria's On Crimes and Punishments,

units.source_text: 这部十八世纪意大利刑法学者撰写的书，是启蒙主义与合理主义的古典式的精神份饭，

en.t: a book written by an eighteenth-century Italian scholar of criminal law, a classic spiritual nourishment of Enlightenment and rationalist thought,

units.source_text: 我刚读了几页就把名扬在一边了。

en.t: but after reading only a few pages I had set it aside.

units.source_text: 不过，说不定这女人对本书的书会有兴趣呢。

en.t: Still, perhaps this woman might be interested in the book.
